{{Quote|Named for the famed Diathim of the moons of Iego, this light, sweet cake has an appropriately heavenly taste! (The trick for getting the cake so fluffy, we've found, is a little bit of patience and a good antigrav whisk.)|Dex's description of the cake on his menu|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Iego angel food cake''' was a type of [[Cake/Legends|cake]] named for the [[Diathim/Legends|Diathim]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. It was served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as a dessert for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of the establishment, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], used an [[antigrav whisk]] in the process of making the cakes, which he claimed tasted heavenly. The use of the antigrav whisk gave them a fluffy texture, although the process required patience. The cake was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Iego angel food cake was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
